summary: Thupten Tsering works in computational fields and Tibetology. He has held academic posts at the University of Electronic Science and Technology of China and Tibet University.
Thushini S. Jayawardena works in religious studies. She earned a PhD from Auckland University of Technology in 2017 and studied under traditional teacher Satya Narayan Goenka.

Théodore Pavie (1811–1896) was an Indologist and Sinologist who studied under Eugène Burnouf around 1833–1845. He succeeded Burnouf at the Collège de France as Professor of Sanskrit (1852–1857) and taught at the Catholic University of the West in 1862.

Thích Minh Châu (1918–2012) was a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a PhD at Babasaheb Bhimrao Ambedkar Bihar University (~1957–1964). He lectured in Chinese at Nava Nalanda Mahavihara (~1958–1964) and served as Vice Chancellor of Vạn Hạnh University (~1964–1975).
Thích Thiện Châu (1931–1998) was a Buddhist studies scholar. He studied at Paris-Sorbonne University and completed a doctoral dissertation at Sorbonne Nouvelle University around 1971–1977.

Tianshu Zhu specializes in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. She earned an MA at Northwest University and a PhD at Ohio State University under John C. Huntington, holding positions at Shaanxi History Museum, Northwest University, Korea University, and Ohio State.

Tilak Kariyawasam (b. 1942) works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He served as head of the Department of Pali and Buddhist Studies at the University of Kelaniya (attested 1993) and Dean of the Graduate School at the International Buddhist College (attested 2014).

Tilmann Vetter (1937–2012) was a scholar of Indology, Buddhist studies, and philosophy. He completed his PhD at the University of Vienna (~1958–1962) under Erich Frauwallner and Erich Heintel, later becoming a professor at Leiden University in 1974.

Timothy Hugh Barrett (b. 1947) specializes in Sinology, Buddhist studies, and religious studies. He studied at the University of Cambridge and Yale University, teaching at Cambridge (attested 1981) before serving as a professor at SOAS University of London from 1986.

Timothy Lenz works in Buddhist studies and Indology. He studied at the University of Washington under Richard G. Salomon and Collett Cox, later holding appointments there, including professor (attested 2017) and faculty member (attested 2026).

Timothy Lubin works in Indology and religious studies. He earned his PhD from Columbia University in 1994, joined the faculty at Washington and Lee University (attested 2012–2020), and collaborated on the ERC dharma project.
Tina Rasmussen specializes in Buddhist studies and religious studies. She studied under traditional teacher Pa-Auk Sayadaw and completed an MA under the supervision of Christian K. Wedemeyer.

Tirumalai Krishnamacharya (1888–1989) was an Indology and philosophy scholar. He studied at Sampurnanand Sanskrit University and the University of Mysore, learning from Ramamohana Brahmachari and others, and taught at Maharaja's Sanskrit College, Mysore (1931) and Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda College (~1952–1955).

Tissa Rajapatirana (1933–2021) specialized in Indology and Buddhist studies. He completed a PhD at the Australian National University (1966–1974) under Jan Willem de Jong and later held a post there in the Department of South Asian and Buddhist Studies (attested 1988).

Tista Biswas works in Indology, studying under doctoral supervisor Subuddhi Charan Goswami (attested 2026). She held the post of Sir William Jones Research Fellow in Sanskritic Studies at The Asiatic Society (attested 2026).
Tiziana Pontillo (b. 1969) is a scholar in Indology and linguistics. She studied at the University of Cagliari in 2016 and held a post there in 2022.
Todd A. Gibson works in Tibetology and religious studies. He studied under György Kara and completed his PhD at Indiana University Bloomington (attested 1991).

Todd Thornton Lewis works in religious studies, Buddhist studies, and Indology. He studied at Columbia University under faculty including Alex Wayman and Margaret Mead, and held appointments at the College of the Holy Cross (attested 1996, 2016–2017).

Tokan Tada (1890–1967) was a Tibetology and Buddhist studies scholar who studied at Sera Monastery (1913–1923). He held appointments at the University of Tokyo (1924), Tohoku University (1925), and the Toyo Bunko Tibetan studies research center (1956).
Toke Lindegaard Knudsen specializes in Indology and history/archaeology. He studied under Kim Plofker and completed his doctorate under David Pingree in 2008.
